name: UPCODEA Store Chat
author: dervisis

sections.description:
UPCODEA Store Chat is an AI chatbot and live chat widget for your WooCommerce storefront. Customers can ask about products in plain language — “do you have this in blue?”, “what’s on sale under $30?”, “is this in stock?” — and get answers generated from your live product catalog, not a stale export.

Developed by UPCODEA.

Key features

  • Floating chat widget with product/category page awareness.
  • Answers grounded in real-time WooCommerce data (price, stock, SKU, description, permalink).
  • Powered by Google Gemini — a generous free tier means most small stores can run it at no AI cost.
  • Nonce-protected, rate-limited REST API endpoint; no API keys ever reach the browser.
  • Configurable widget appearance (title, button label, colors).
  • Optional site-wide daily reply cap to protect against unexpected API costs.
  • Guardrails keep the bot on-topic and resistant to prompt-injection attempts from users.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0+
  • A free Google Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com/apikey

Third-party service

UPCODEA Store Chat relies on the Google Gemini API to generate chat replies. To do so, the plugin sends the visitor’s chat message and a small, relevant slice of your product catalog (name, price, stock, SKU, short description, permalink) to Google’s servers for each chat turn. No chat content is stored on your own server; conversation history lives only in the visitor’s browser for the duration of the session.

By using this plugin you are sending customer-submitted data to a third party. Please review and link to in your own store’s privacy policy:

  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google Gemini API Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

UPCODEA Store Chat adds suggested language to your site’s Privacy Policy draft automatically (Settings → Privacy → “Suggest Text”) — review and publish it before going live.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the upcodea-store-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must already be installed and active.
  3. Go to UPCODEA Store Chat in the wp-admin menu.
  4. Paste a free Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com/apikey.
  5. Customize the widget title, button label and colors as needed.
  6. Review Settings → Privacy and publish the suggested disclosure text.
sections.faq:
Does this cost money to run?

The plugin itself doesn’t add a subscription fee. Google Gemini has a free tier (gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite) generous enough for most small-to-medium stores. You can also set a daily reply cap in the plugin’s settings to hard-limit usage.

Where does the customer’s data go?

Chat messages and a relevant slice of your product catalog are sent to Google’s Gemini API to generate a reply. See the “Third-party service” section above.

Can I use my own OpenAI/Claude key instead of Gemini?

Not in the current version — Gemini-only for now.

Does the bot see private/draft products?

No. The catalog query only fetches published, publicly visible products via WooCommerce’s own product query APIs.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

All plugin options and transients are removed automatically on deletion (not on simple deactivation).
sections.changelog:
0.3.0

  • Added: smarter product search. Natural-language questions are now translated into catalog search keywords (including an English translation, since most catalogs use English product titles) before searching, so phrasing that shares no words with a product’s title or description — including questions asked in a different language — can still find it.

0.2.1

  • Fixed: the floating button, header, user message bubble, and send button colors could be silently overridden by theme CSS that sets background-color on generic button selectors. Colors are now set explicitly (including the background-color longhand, not just the background shorthand) with the priority needed to respect the color pickers in the plugin settings.

0.2.0

  • Changed: plugin name to “UPCODEA Store Chat” and text domain to upcodea-store-chat. The original working name (“WoobotAI”) was flagged during WordPress.org review as confusingly similar to an existing WooCommerce chatbot plugin and to a registered chatbot trademark, so it was replaced before the first public release.
  • Added: site-wide daily reply cap to protect against unexpected API costs.
  • Added: uninstall.php to fully clean up plugin data on removal.
  • Added: Privacy Policy suggested-text integration and in-widget data disclaimer.
  • Added: minimum PHP version check with a graceful admin notice.
  • Improved: friendlier handling of Gemini safety-blocked responses.
  • Improved: error logging via the WooCommerce logger for easier troubleshooting.
  • Fixed: chat now falls back to catalog search if an invalid product_id is supplied.
  • Reduced: outbound AI request timeout to avoid PHP execution-time fatals on shared hosting.

0.1.0

  • Initial MVP: chat widget, REST endpoint, WooCommerce catalog context, Gemini integration, admin settings.
